verdict.rationale: dltHub ships a first-party AI Harness of skills, rules, and MCP servers that lets coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex build, deploy, and run pipelines from natural-language prompts such as 'I want to ingest pull requests and issues from the GitHub REST API'. An official MCP server exposes tools for inspecting, debugging, and managing pipelines, and for running read-only SQL, so operation, not just authoring, can be driven conversationally. missing for 10: a native built-in natural-language interface (it depends on a third-party coding agent), independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, and deeper documentation of the full command coverage.
